Package org.apache.hadoop.io.compress

Interface DirectDecompressionCodec

All Superinterfaces:
CompressionCodec
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultCodec, GzipCodec
@Public @Evolving public interface DirectDecompressionCodec extends CompressionCodec
This class encapsulates a codec which can decompress direct bytebuffers.
